contract.purpose: Expose the full canonical MyGRACE skill set as deterministic MAGRA commands and runnable playbooks.
contract.scope: Register all 14 MyGRACE skills, map slash names, load skill bodies lazily, and dispatch inline or service-backed workflows.

skill-set.skill-1: init, plan, verification, execute, multiagent, refactor, refresh
skill-set.skill-2: fix, reviewer, status, ask, explainer, cli, setup-subagents

invariants.invariant-1: Slash names use `/mygrace:*` even when underlying Reasonix skill IDs cannot contain colon.
invariants.invariant-2: Skill bodies load on demand to preserve cache-first context discipline.
